speaker: Pep Guardiola embargoed
quote_text:
We'll set the embargo for 10:30 on Sunday evening.  Martin, please. You've got this game, this quick  
turnaround for Tuesday now. Is that a bigger game  than this was in some ways because there's so much  
riding on it, isn't there? No, no, we'll have to  recover quick. Yeah, it's a big disappointment  
today, you know, because of course we are here  for the win. Listen, when we lose, when you play  
not good, you are sad, but at the end, we don't  deserve it. But when you play that way, I'm sorry,  
with a final underplay, we play and the players  gave absolutely everything and we create like  
we create. Not necessarily because I didn't see  the stats or whatever, but this game is about to  
score a goal. So we didn't score, we didn't have  defend, you know, we didn't have defend. So we  
didn't score. Congratulations, Crystal Palace. And  now, of course, we don't have much time to recover  
and prepare an important game from wins against  Bournemouth. Hi, Pep. Very big summer ahead for  
you and the team and the club. Do you think it's  maybe one of the biggest challenges you've had  
in your years at City to rebuild ahead of next  season? And how confident are you that you can,  
given that you've got a Club World Cup, etc.,  that you can get the squad to the start line in  
the position that you want them to be next season?  But I would say after nine years, we have already  
rebuilt. So in nine years, you are not the same  players like when we arrive. But I think the club  
have ideas, and from my point of view now, well,  we have two massive important games for the short  
future for this club, and after we take a break,  sure games go to World Cup, in that process,  
the club will take a decision you have  to take. I know it's an obvious question,  
but just how important is the Champions League  finish? And then also, I guess, you know,  
the players are exhausted physically, how much  is a mental challenge coming to it and their  
winning mentality? Well, we have to have to come  up, we have to live. Of course, it's better to  
play against Bournemouth winning the Cup. They  give you, you know, wins help winning, but we  
have to—that is the proof how strong we are, so in  our people. So, when we play bad, I'm incredible,  
and it's always I'm here to say we don't deserve  it. It happened last season against United. Like  
I said, we don't play good, but this year, I don't  have that feeling, so I don't give any reddit or  
compliment to Crystal Palace. They deserve it in  the way they play and congratulations to them. So,  
I think, but I had the feeling that today we  made a really, really good game. It's obvious,  
as to Arsenal, Chelsea, or you know, Nottingham  Forest, Newcastle, us to be there, of course,  
it's important, massive. But to have now is not  time to, I would say, to talk to the players'  
minds. So tomorrow's half recovery and after  pregame, and we would see how we prepare. I  
want to see how we recover the players and go  there. Last one was Simon, please guys. Can I  
ask what was it that meant that Rico and McAtee  didn't make the squad? For just one reason,  
it was, I said before, three or four times, it's  so difficult for I think all the managers. Now,  
we brought some few players in the winter  time, and now all the players are recovered,  
and we have 24 players. And the last four or five,  all the time, three players were out all the time.  
And I wanted to change a little bit because I  don't have anything against, of course, Rico,  
McAtee, because I love, I appreciate. Nathan came  back in the first week training and then I try to  
be fair with the guys, not just to disappointment  for that or for that reason. Thank you.
title: Pep Guardiola embargoed post-match press conference | Crystal Palace 1-0 Man City | FA Cup Final
